cases.prompt: 用这张山水照片做一个高级、简洁、手机端也漂亮的落地页，你决定风格。
cases.fixture: one high-resolution 3:2 landscape with open sky and a protected horizon
expectedBehaviors: audits and views the supplied image before layout
scores plausible profiles instead of defaulting from the word premium
protects the horizon and proves an independent mobile crop
failureSignals: copies a prior seasonal hero composition
places oversized type across the focal landscape

cases.prompt: Turn these architecture photos into a refined portfolio with subtle motion.

expectedBehaviors: Quiet Luxury receives evidence-based consideration
motion is tied to light, shadow, reveal, or material
failureSignals: adds petals, birds, or dreamlike script without image evidence
